about: Ramps the staff art needs that art/palette.json does not have yet, in the palette file's 'shared' format (the same in every style set). Each is meant to move into art/palette.json 'shared' as it is; until then staff_palette.py merges them over the house palette. Dark to light.

tint.label: neutral grey for vertex-colour tinting (the badge and its cord; the game multiplies it by the team colour)

leaf.label: leaf green (the lily's stem and leaf)
